precondition: unique augment-dictionary extraction consumes hline, vline and stroke while accepting and discarding remaining keys

variants.transform: after consuming known fields, turn any remaining unknown key into an error without changing known-field casts
when hline is absent, alias the first remaining unknown key's value into hline so it becomes visible in carrier/repr, without changing known-field casts

validity: Both variants are valid and M10 is killed only when P33 kills each while P13, N08 and N10 retain their frozen classifications.
